family.triumph-adler-alphatronic-pc.desc: The compact Alphatronics with integrated keyboards.
family.triumph-adler-alphatronic-pc.hist: Triumph-Adler presented the Alphatronic PC in Hanover in 1983 as the entry model in its range. The PC used a Z80, and the later PC16 returned to the format with an 8088.
